D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Paul Tonko leads by 26.5 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 72,037 votes; a one point swing is about 1,361 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +19.1 and D +33.6. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$467K cash against $12K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
